fabricated_details: Investigate and resolve the recurring issue

rationale: The report captures all issues and correctly flags the unrecognized equipment. However, it fabricates several operational details (status 'Ongoing', specific instructions to investigate/troubleshoot, and notifications to Maintenance/Engineering) not found in the input. Severities were assigned confidently (HIGH/CRITICAL) despite no evidence in the input to justify those specific levels over UNKNOWN.
